Table Tennis Federation of India's Recognition Suspended

The Table Tennis Federation of India (TTFI) has acknowledged the suspension of its recognition. The federation has stressed its autonomy and flagged the implications of this suspension. TTFI has urged the Ministry to reconsider its order regarding the suspension.
